name: k14-multi-tool-call-consistency
title: K14 multi-provider tool-call consistency
description: Keep every tool call in multi-call turns across providers: Anthropic multiple tool_use blocks (non-stream+stream), Gemini streamed same-name calls, Ollama multiple calls, and single-call streaming providers share one accumulation/collection helper; LLMResponse + LLMClient handle all calls per turn with backward compatibility; per-provider tests under tests/llms/. No new deps; Python 3.10.
